✓ Natural gas.fact: Natural gas (also gas, methane gas or fossil gas) is a fossil fuel, naturally occurring in geological formations. Methane is a colorless and odorless gas, and, after carbon dioxide, is the second-greatest greenhouse gas that contributes to global climate change.  Because natural gas is odorless, a commercial odorizer, such as methanethiol, that smells of hydrogen sulfide (rotten eggs) is added to the gas for the ready detection of gas leaks.
